Choosing the right coverage

The right photographer or videographer does more than turn up on the day. They plan the run sheet with you, read the room, and deliver images and film you will keep for years.

Shortlisting two or three providers who cover Melbourne lets you compare style, coverage hours and inclusions before you commit.

Planning tip. Golden-hour light early in the evening makes for the best candids, so leave a little photo time before sunset.

Common questions in Melbourne

How much does a wedding photographer cost in Melbourne?
What a wedding photographer costs in Melbourne depends on coverage hours, the number of shooters, editing and inclusions like albums or prints. Requesting quotes from photographers who cover Melbourne is the best way to see real local pricing for your day.
How many hours of coverage do I need?
Most full weddings are covered across six to ten hours, from getting ready to the reception. Shorter events and corporate functions may only need two to four hours. Tell us your run sheet and we will help match coverage to it.
Do photographers who cover Melbourne travel to my venue?
Most providers list a service area and many travel beyond it for a small fee. When you enquire, mention your Melbourne venue so they can confirm coverage and any travel costs.
How do I choose between two providers?
Start with the portfolio and the style you connect with, then compare coverage hours, inclusions and turnaround. A quick call also tells you a lot about how they will work on the day.
